notes.title: Update 1.1 - editor!
notes.notes:
Editor! Yes! Create your own levels! It's still in a Beta, but you can use any action tile or art that you can find it the game. So you can create any level you want.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26258364/938a953a2762cfe79794cb527113a1b6c84ab93d.jpg[/img]

Send your levels to us and if we have enough levels, we will create a special level pack (as a free bonus for all)!

Regards,
  Pavel, Rake in Grass..
